title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30329: override confirmation text in CancelPostedInvoiceAndOpenSalesOrder
summary: An integration event allows extensions to override the confirmation text when canceling a posted sales invoice, enabling accurate messaging when custom logic changes the behavior applied to the originating sales order.
key_points: New integration event `OnCancelPostedInvoiceAndOpenSalesOrderOnBeforeConfirm` added to codeunit 1322
Extensions can now override confirmation question text instead of duplicating the procedure logic
Confirmation text is stored in a variable before being shown to users
Event exposes sales invoice header, sales header, and the confirmation text parameter
Addresses inconsistency when extensions customize how posted invoice corrections affect originating order quantities
quote: an extension can override the confirmation question text before it is shown, without duplicating the procedure's logic
